entries: Historical PAR RMS/CHI2R was not an equivalent fixed-model acceptance test. Two independent likelihood formulations agree.
Retain historical discrepancies and failed attempts; do not claim exact historical reproduction.
Exact fit-window inclusion, direct timing/noise checks and independent likelihood audits passed.
No source observations or noise amplitudes changed; qualified scientific runtime preserved.
Seven calibrations and one observed search each; zero candidates or execution failures. Original six preserved.
Original 13-case conditional 1% allowance; 4,096 nulls per new target; masks and sensitivities retained.
14 IPTA datasets searched including J1721; six coverage and 45 companion exclusions retained.
UTMOST-NS still needs combined timing inputs. No further search queued; prior candidate reviews preserved.
